claims.claim: OFFLIMITS offers apparel across tracksuits, joggers, hoodies, sweatshirts and tees, alongside footwear categories.
The Men's Sonic Tracksuit is light grey/A Force with full sleeves, cut-and-sew construction, Wicktech and polyester-spandex fabric.
The Women's Glaze Tracksuit is grey melange with a cotton/polyfleece fabric, hooded top and cargo pocket.
The Men's Titan T-shirt uses a bold varsity-style 07 graphic visible in official product photography.
The black Bomba is a lace-up lifestyle sneaker with a synthetic upper, TPR sole and EVA insock.

claims.criteria: Every remaining use of the word top is a garment noun, such as hooded top or lower half, and never a superiority or ranking claim.
